name: Pixel Fancy
source:
Pixel Fancy is a short visual novel about a games industry veteran who still has plenty of room to learn and grow! Play as Mika (whose name can be changed) as she navigates the creative world of gaming, building friendships (and more?) along the way.

[from [url=https://happysadpotato.itch.io/pixel-fancy-demo]itch.io[/url]]
